Dismissing these stellar current metrics as an isolated spike [E16] overlooks the reality that Terraform Realstate Ltd is currently operating at elite levels of profitability while the broader sector remains mired in deeply negative returns [E3, E4, E5].

Therefore, treating an isolated recent spike [E16] as permanent operational outperformance ignores the clear evidence of cyclical or transient volatility in the company's long-term operating history.
